reason: Internal: governance adoption, no production code and nothing a member of a room can observe. The project adopts UACP (Universal Agent Control Plane, mikeng-io/uacp) as its control plane, installed as a Claude Code plugin at PROJECT scope, and gains PRINCIPLE.md — the outermost declared intent every later phase grounds against. PRINCIPLE.md was DERIVED FROM THE IMPLEMENTATION rather than authored: four parallel read-only comprehension readers over the kernel and entrypoints, the config as-wired, what the tests actually pin, and the git trajectory across 2,449 commits, reconciled into one statement plus eight invariants, each bound to a cited mechanism. The statement: Nora manufactures trustworthy restraint — an agent that can be left running unattended in a private group because what she will NOT do is enforced in code rather than requested of a model, and because every claim the project makes about itself is built to be mechanically falsified. The eight invariants are silence as a first-class outcome with teeth (R-97, the participation exclusions, SILENT as success); uncalled speech being at-most-once with lost preferred to duplicated; deny-by-default re-checked at the moment of use; record-before-deciding and record-before-speaking; one fail-closed egress checking both the rendered and the raw form; refusing to start rather than running while looking healthy; an instruction to a model never counting as a guarantee; and a measurement taken through a proxy not counting as a measurement. THE FRONTIER IS THE HONEST PART, and it is the reason this adoption happened: the enforcement is voluntary. There is no CI — .github/workflows/ does not exist, so 5,570 tests, 37 architecture tests and six import contracts fire only when a human types make gate, and the git hooks check commit-message grammar only. The consequences are already measurable: R-85 cites a test node that does not exist, twelve enforced rules are absent from the decision index, AGENTS.md names a PII gate that is not on disk, two production modules cite a test_module_size.py that was never written, and the package holding the guards and the egress is not type-checked. The single largest recurring issue class in the tree is a thing that claims to enforce something enforces nothing, and it recurs because the outermost enforcer is absent. A FIRST FINDING was also recorded: the README sells a three-platform ambient agent while composition refuses to boot without Signal regardless of Discord or WhatsApp, roughly 25 subsystems ship inert, the relevance gate ships in shadow so she never speaks unprompted even when enabled, and the README says eval zero times while evaluation is fourteen issues, seventy-seven commits and the current branch. The derivation ran INSIDE a governed UACP run, and the gate earned its place on the first attempt: the brainstorm-to-triage transition was REFUSED because Heartgate could not load config/phase-transitions.yaml, which this project did not have. Provisioning it is what this change also carries — UACP's config machinery and an empty .uacp/ workspace, with UACP's own forty-three accumulated knowledge files deliberately NOT copied across. The agreement is recorded as a governed provenance node binding the operator's assent to the exact sha256 of PRINCIPLE.md, so a later edit makes the stale agreement mechanically detectable. LIMITS: the sweep was bounded and says so in its scope package — the Standing fold, all fifty-six tool bodies, most of the fire path, the whole of nora/web, nora/infra and nora/domain, every platform adapter, and every design bundle in full were not read; 5,570 test functions were counted, not read; and no gate was executed, so every in-gate claim is read off the Makefile and pyproject rather than off a green run. Installing UACP into a foreign project is not yet a documented path — the session-start hook resolves a foreign workspace root but the MCP server's Heartgate did not, and the operator is addressing that in the UACP repository.
